scope: Frozen external validation of existing inlier vs geometry-quality ranking; no algorithm/threshold/frontend tuning, no commit/push
frame_order: lexicographic image filenames; first5, first3, or fixed index triplet; no GT overlap, quality or performance based selection
preprocessing: Pillow bilinear isotropic fit within800x600, never upscale; preserve complete image, no crop/padding. GaussianBlur radius4 in original grid BEFORE resize for blur5. K'=A*K with exact pixel-center affine. New cross-dataset resource profile shared by all strategies; native Middlebury640x480 retained.
metrics: Same failure-aware joint angle/linear pose scores@5/10/20, correct initialization<=5, all-input-pairs accurate complete map<=5, registered/correct cameras, false>5/severe>20, accepted-pair p95/max, BA/reprojection proxy, attempts/time/RSS/actual GPU. Equal conditions within scene, equal scenes within family; report each family separately, not hundreds of independent scenes.
decision: Primary LightGlue C: challenger may replace incumbent inliers only if both new-family macro score10 are nondecreasing, complete-accurate map and correct-camera rates nondecreasing, false and severe rates nonincreasing in EACH family, no scene has increased severe count, and at least one accuracy/success/error metric strictly improves in BOTH families. Also inspect previous DTU harm. If tradeoffs or no dominance: no universal winner, retain simpler incumbent inliers as provisional engineering reference, keep quality as explicit candidate, never delete failures. RootSIFT-ratio frontend evaluated separately, cannot substitute its outcome for primary frontend.
selection_interpretation: These previously unseen sequences become external validation evidence after this one-shot selection. No claim of untouched final test or broad generalization; report calibration uncertainty (Middlebury ~pixel-level) and related acquisition sequences.
stops: Run fixed matrix720 reconstructions only; no tuning or replacing failed scenes. Access failures/invalid camera/feature guard/OOM kept as unavailable in original planned denominator. If download would exceed budget, stop requesting images and report; do not full-clone image repo or download ETH3D500MB+ packs. All existing artifacts remain.
